question: What will Andrew Cuomo say during victory / concession speech?
description:
If Andrew Cuomo says Father / Mario Cuomo as part of victory / concession speech, then the market resolves to Yes.
Video of the victory / concession speech will be primarily used to resolve the market; if a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, transcripts of the victory / concession speech will be used according to the news publications listed in the contract. The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word, must be used. Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. Please see full rules for more details. For the purpose of this market, the event will count as both a victory or concession speech.

question: Will Zohran Mamdani concede defeat in the their respective race before Nov 5, 2025?
description:
If Zohran Mamdani has made a statement conceding defeat in the 2025 New York City Mayoral election before Nov 5, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
A concession requires Zohran Mamdani to explicitly acknowledge defeat, loss, or that their opponent has won 2025 New York City Mayoral election. This may include statements using words such as "concede," "congratulate [opponent] on their victory," "accept the results," "will not be [office holder]" or other unambiguous acknowledgments of defeat.
